profile.name: Rishabh Patre
profile.role: Senior Product Manager @ Justdial | Leads & AI

summary: I specialise in building products that solve complex business problems, scale digital platforms, and drive measurable growth.

At Justdial, I lead product strategy across marketplace growth, **AI-powered lead lifecycle and seller retention**. One of my key initiatives is **Lead Bank, a commercial offering that has generated ₹135+ crore in business**, combining AI, intelligent lead distribution, and marketplace strategy to improve business outcomes.
I've also led multiple AI initiatives across the company, spanning multilingual voice AI, conversational AI, speech analytics, and intelligent automation.

I've driven organic discovery across platforms generating **100M+ monthly organic visits** and delivered 0-to-1 and omnichannel commerce solutions for brands including **Swiggy, Nykaa, and Skechers**.
My work combines **product strategy, AI, growth, and commercial thinking** to build scalable products that create meaningful customer and business impact.

rolesDetails.role: Senior Product Manager – Marketplace Growth & AI Products
points: Lead product strategy across marketplace growth, lead generation and fulfilment, seller acquisition, and retention, spanning the seller lifecycle from targeting and onboarding to lead delivery and renewals.

Spearhead **Lead Bank**, a commercial offering that has generated **₹135+ crore in business**, combining AI-led lead qualification and intelligent lead distribution to connect buyer demand with business sellers.
Lead multiple AI products across **multilingual voice AI, conversational AI, and speech analytics**, improving lead quality, automating operations, and unlocking new business opportunities.
Automated 2L+ monthly listing verification calls through **Voice AI**, achieving 94% data accuracy and **₹3Cr+ in annual operational savings**.
Scaled speech analytics across **1L+ daily calls**, delivering **₹4Cr+ in annual cost savings** and unlocking approximately **30K qualified leads per day** from non-paid calls.
Led **GEO/AEO initiatives** to improve Justdial's visibility across generative AI platforms, enabling 5M+ daily AI crawls and driving approximately **1M monthly visits** from LLM discovery channels.
Owned cross-platform **growth strategy** across web and mobile platforms to scale user traffic and leads on Justdial.
Orchestrated **SEO Revamp 2.0**, delivering **35% YoY organic traffic growth** and scaling the platform to **6M+ daily visits**.
Launched **multilingual pages** across **6 regional languages**, driving **5M+ monthly organic traffic** through automated translation workflows.
Partnered with marketing to improve **performance marketing efficiency**, reducing **CAC by 18%** through better audience targeting and landing page relevance.
Implemented **data analytics pipelines** using **GA4** and internal analytics systems to track real-time user behavior and improve retention insights.
Recognized with the **Top Impactor Award** for delivering high-impact growth initiatives.
Built and owned **order fulfillment** flows for JD Shopping, and later led JD Mart (B2B marketplace) through its early-stage growth and scale-up.
Introduced **non-regional B2B Results pages** and added auto-generated catalogues, seller videos, and dynamic Q&As, resulting in a **100% increase** in results page user visits via Google.
Added **lead generating avenues** on pages contributing to a **50% increase** in click on lead CTAs.
Launched **JD Shopping**, an open quick commerce platform empowering local retailers to sell online.
Led 5+ logistics **partner integrations** from scratch and built a multi-LSP order allocation engine for optimized fulfillment.
Led the **Omnichannel Order and Inventory Management** platforms, enabling real-time stock sync across 15+ marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra).
Owned the **0->1** build of Vin OMS 2.0, shaping vision, architecture, and roadmap to deliver a modular, standalone OMS serving as the central orchestration layer for unified commerce.
Optimized **Order Routing Algorithms** to automatically assign orders to the nearest warehouse, reducing shipping costs and delivery times by 20%.
Worked closely with clients like **Skechers and Swiggy Instamart** to gather requirements and built custom integrations for their specific logistics workflows.
Conducted extensive **Gap Analysis** for enterprise clients migrating to SaaS-based OMS/WMS solutions.
Documented detailed **BRDs (Business Requirement Documents)**, bridging the communication gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Facilitated **UAT (User Acceptance Testing)** phases for major deployments, ensuring zero critical bugs upon go-live.
Assisted in the **Pre-sales** process by creating product demos and proof-of-concept workflows for potential enterprise leads.

projectShowcase.title: Lead Bank — Marketplace Product Strategy & Growth
projectShowcase.description: Leading product strategy and execution for Justdial's Lead Bank offering, connecting buyer acquisition and AI-powered lead qualification with intelligent lead distribution, seller fulfilment, and commercial growth.
impact: 💰 Scaled Lead Bank into a commercial offering generating ₹135+ crore in business
🤖 Connected AI-powered buyer qualification across voice bots, chatbots, WhatsApp, and AI call-listening systems
🎯 Built product workflows spanning seller targeting, onboarding, lead qualification, distribution, and fulfilment
📈 Combined verified leads with premium catalogues, 360° photography, and talking product videos in annual packages starting at ₹50,000
🔄 Connected lead availability and seller outcomes with retention and renewal initiatives
🚀 Driving product development for expansion into B2C categories
highlights: Owned product strategy across the seller lifecycle, from market selection and onboarding to lead delivery, seller value, and retention
Connected AI-led lead qualification with commercial strategy and marketplace fulfilment
Defined lead scoring, prioritization, category-city matching, and dynamic expiry rules to allocate buyer demand across eligible sellers
Worked cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams to translate marketplace problems into product workflows and measurable outcomes

sections.title: Market & Seller Targeting
bullets: **Category & City Prioritization:** Evaluated buyer demand, marketplace liquidity, and seller coverage to identify high-potential categories and markets.
**Seller Eligibility:** Defined product-led targeting criteria using catalogue readiness, seller coverage, and fulfilment potential.
**Product-Led Go-to-Market:** Aligned targeting and activation with market readiness to improve the likelihood of sellers receiving relevant leads after onboarding.

sections.title: Seller Onboarding & Activation
bullets: **Activation Journey:** Mapped the journey from package signup to activation, identifying friction between purchase and becoming ready to receive leads.
**Catalogue Readiness:** Coordinated product workflows for product information, specifications, 360° photography, and talking product videos required for a stronger digital presence.
**Time to First Lead:** Focused on reducing the gap between seller activation and the delivery of the first relevant lead.

sections.title: AI-Powered Lead Qualification
bullets: **Multi-Channel AI:** Drove product workflows across multilingual voice bots, conversational chatbots, WhatsApp bots, and AI call-listening systems.
**Requirement Extraction:** Converted buyer conversations into structured requirements, including product specifications, quantity, budget, location, and purchase timeline where available.
**Lead Verification:** Used buyer intent and requirement signals to distinguish actionable enquiries from low-quality or irrelevant leads.

sections.title: Lead Scoring & Distribution
bullets: **Lead Scoring:** Combined qualification signals and requirement quality to prioritize leads based on their potential value.
**Seller Matching:** Defined allocation rules using category relevance, city coverage, seller eligibility, and lead availability.
**Distribution & Expiry:** Managed distribution across Open Lead and Lead Bank workflows, using prioritization and dynamic expiry to balance lead freshness with seller access.

sections.title: Fulfilment & Seller Experience
bullets: **Lead Availability:** Monitored gaps between seller package activation and actual lead delivery to identify underserved accounts.
**Fulfilment Analytics:** Used lead availability, seller engagement, and fulfilment signals to identify bottlenecks and prioritize product improvements.
**Seller Value Realization:** Connected lead distribution and seller experience with the broader goal of helping sellers derive value from their packages.

sections.title: Retention & Commercial Growth
bullets: **Seller Health & Retention:** Used fulfilment and engagement signals to identify potential dissatisfaction and opportunities to improve renewal outcomes.
**Commercial Proposition:** Combined verified leads with premium catalogues, 360° photography, and talking product videos in annual packages starting at ₹50,000.
**B2C Expansion:** Driving product development to extend lead qualification and marketplace capabilities into B2C categories.

projectShowcase.title: Speech Analytics for Verification, Growth & Risk Control
projectShowcase.description: Led a speech analytics initiative at Justdial that applied a shared ASR + semantic intelligence pipeline to solve multiple high-impact business problems—spanning business verification, lead generation, spam control, and operational efficiency.
impact: 📞 Millions of calls analysed using a shared speech intelligence approach
💰 ₹3.2 Cr annual savings from TME call verification alone
💰 ₹90L+ additional annual savings from IRO & CS efficiency improvements
📈 +30K leads/day unlocked from non-paid seller calls

highlights: Solving multiple business problems with one coherent architectural mindset
Designing evidence-first verification instead of black-box classification
Knowing when not to use an LLM
Balancing accuracy, explainability, cost, and scale
